subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same die are shown below. What is the number on the face opposite to the face having 1?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51126b40afd97aa9d7860f1e4f1df5b33d14f7ce287df5966e74174e5e6a8b6c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 2, 5, 6, and 4 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1324a8eb7bf77cb514128e3c1a272cc03e8453db7298defc932e4ef18d98ba3.png] 

Opposite pairs:

2 → 4

5 → 6

3 → 1

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
